positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore has been providing expert consulting to an HR group in the ODNI organization to identify technical solutions to their varied business processes.   As a result, he investigated and defined their business processes, reengineered their processes providing more efficient procedures to help manage their data.  His recommendations included necessary changes in data manipulations and storage.  He defined and investigated the infrastructure needed, the database and user feasibility requirements and provided several different solutions to the customer.   He has been advising from a technical and user standpoint the SharePoint sites that are being created and identified the impact to the overall development of the HR process.  Mr. Bazemore has created several prototypes utilizing J2EE methodology, MyEclipse IDE, JASPER report functionality and Oracle tools throughout this assignment.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore has been supporting a tools development group which requires him to design and develop applications per customer requirements utilizing J2EE methodology.  Mr. Bazemore has developed and designed a J2EE application that accesses a Oracle database that provides pertinent data for the customer.  Mr. Bazemore has also been on standby support for additional Windows and UNIX based systems investigating the software and additional customer requirements and using various scripting languages (Perl, Ruby, PHP, AWK) to manipulate, extract and import data.  Presently developing in the Java arena, using Eclipse development tools to build and enhance deployed applications in a large scale development team environment.(Agile methodology

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore supported a data mining project which required him to develop and engineer solutions on different platforms.  Mr. Bazemore identified user end-requirements, developed them using methodology techniques and also built and designed a total solution utilizing hardware and software implementations.  Some of the solutions required J2EE development, JAVA-Swing development, scripting development (PERL/PYTHON, AWK) and database implementations.  Mr. Bazemore engineered methods provided methods for COTS products to be integrated into the group's overall solution model.  Support of hardware implementations in Windows and Unix/Linux environments has also been a constant requirement while building and maintaining networks per user requirements.

positions.title: Computer Solutions & Software Development
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore supported small development efforts and engineering projects as an independent consultant.  Some of his projects included building computer systems, designing and developing user interfaces/products and programming in languages such as PERL, C, C++, or JAVA per user requirements.  Projects included working on development projects at NIMA,  agency projects within the CIA, and projects for venture capital companies. Worked as a senior software developer for VDOT, re-engineering their Automated Traffic Management System.(Software and Hardware in a Unix environment

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Independent Consultant
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore worked as a senior software engineer responsible for redesigning and rebuilding a previously protoyped JAVA application. (MACACCESS).  Mr. Bazemore also worked as senior software engineer on the Joint Readiness Project.  His responsibilities include programming, developing and modifying a Java based Readiness program which utilizes the Status of Resources and Training Database (Sorts

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Independent Consultant
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore was responsible for developing and designing a messaging system which was used as the main communication system within the agency.  Mr. Bazemore was also responsible for providing integration support/programming in the CT-Link laboratory developing UNIX solutions on Solaris 7.0 and 2.6 in order to communicate with web services operating simultaneous NT and UNIX environments.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore migrated a large heterogeneous UNIX/Windows NT client/server real time system from a Solaris 1.1 to a Solaris 2.6 operating environment on the EDS CES contract for the Directorate of Operations (DO).  Developed code to simulate messaging traffic that occurs during actual operation for integration and testing of the system.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: for design and certification of software for the Defense Information Security Agency Common Operating Environment DII-COE Project and Monies Project, redesigning, enhancing and developing software in an OS/390 UNIX environment. Mr. Bazemore was responsible for developing and building the architecture for Web service products, and building Web server and firewalls UNIX platforms.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore was Senior Programmer on the Logicon Message Dissemination System (LMDS) project at the CIA, responsible for developing, enhancing, and redesigning software. He supported sites already using the LMDS system and was also responsible for porting software to various platforms, modifying and redesigning software to operate on the latest versions of UNIX.

positions.title: Lead programmer
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore was Lead Programmer for the Telephone Routing Interactive System (TRIS) project for the IRS, responsible for the design and development of the transcript request functionality operating on the IRS Interactive Processors (IP-AT&T UNIX based Pyramid Mini-computers). Utilized Yourdon/DeMarco methodology to design the transcript application per system requirements and system capabilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore was lead software engineer for software development and support on the Defense Department's GCCS/SORTS and SORTS Modernization effort. He investigated and designed implementations of various software solutions, and developed applications accessing the SORTS database using Xwindow toolkits (Motif

positions.title: Technical Staff Engineer
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore was responsible for development and design of GUI tools to effectively test the capacity and response time of flight development scenarios for the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).  He was responsible for adding additional capabilities to an ASG scenario generator to provide further in depth analysis of the capacity of simulated ATC facilities and their responsible traffic flow patterns per FAA generated requirements.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: Mr. Bazemore was involved in the overall design and development of the stores management system in the AV-8B Harrier. Troubleshot and repaired AV-8B armament systems equipment and accompanying test equipment. Implemented system modification designs for the customer and assisted in the upgrade of the avionics simulation test station.
